up-figlet: parts, licences and where the source is

Part     Licence                          Source
-------  -------------------------------  -------------------
figlet   BSD-3-Clause (licenses/figlet)   upterm-ports (pkgs/figlet)

Notes
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/figlet/SOURCES.txt.
